brief:
Israeli voters turned decisively against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's coalition in recent elections, according to Middle East Eye. The opposition bloc now holds the numbers to form a government if it can unite around a platform.

The opposition faces a critical juncture, with the potential to form a minority government that would include Arab parties for the first time. Whether the factions can assemble a governing coalition remains uncertain, as negotiations between the various political groups are set to begin.
dek: Has Israel ousted Netanyahu for good? Israelis voted against Netanyahu's coalition in a decisive majority. Will the opposition bloc seize this historic moment and form a minority government with the Arab parties?
title: Israeli voters reject Netanyahu in decisive swing
